Disaggregation profile diagnostic

Source: R/plotting.R
plot_disagg_profile.Rd

For a single group and forecast year, overlays grouped rates as horizontal step bars, GAM raw, parametric, blended (pre-correction), and final corrected curves. A dashed vertical line marks the blend centre.

Usage

plot_disagg_profile(
  disagg,
  mx_grouped,
  ages,
  width = 5,
  fc_year_idx = 1L,
  group_idx = 1L,
  open_mid = 95,
  output_dir,
  cause_short,
  group_label = ""
)

Arguments

disagg

Return value from disaggregate_forecast_gam.

mx_grouped

Numeric vector of grouped rates for this group/year.

ages

Integer vector of age-group starts.

width

Age-group width (default 5).

fc_year_idx

Integer index into forecast years (default 1).

group_idx

Integer group index (default 1).

open_mid

Blend centre age (default 95).

output_dir

Output directory.

cause_short

Short cause label for filename.

group_label

Character label for subtitle.
